'''Coruscant brandy''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] favored the drink and usually drank a synthesized version which made it alcohol-free.<ref name="X-Wing">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>
